meaning:
κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH Dan.7:10, 26, (דִּין), Su 1:49, Exo.21:6, Jdg.5:10 * ;]
1. a means of judging, test, criterion.
2. a tribunal: 1Co.6:2 6:4, Jas.2:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
